name: ALX Oncology Holdings Inc.
summary: ALX Oncology Holdings Inc., a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, focuses on developing therapies for cancer patients in the United States. The company's lead product candidate is Evorpacept, a CD47 blocking therapeutic biologic development as a combination therapy with other anti-cancer agents, including ASPEN-06, under phase 2 clinical study for treating Gastric/GEJ cancer.
